notes.title: v1.0.7: Day 7 Patch!
notes.notes:
- Cutscene adjustments and polishing
- Ensure sprint tutorial appears each time the player gets coffee
- Adjusted fog and lighting
- Several quality-of-life fixes!

notes.title: v1.0.6: Day 5 Patch!
notes.notes:
- Show notification in the main menu when a new arcade level is available. A small visual reward for unlocking new levels!
- Ensure unlocked story nodes are not shared by different profiles
- Language Select, Profile Select, and Splash Screen are now responsive
- Several quality of life fixes!

notes.title: v1.0.3: Day 1 Patch!
notes.notes:
- FPS capped at 60 fps
- Broadcast viewing on level completion fixed for irregular viewing angles
- Localization for Profile Selection menus
- UI Navigation fixes for Profile Selection menus
- UI responsiveness pass for Secrets and "DONE!" screen
- Murderous Mountains will not be unlocked prematurely
- Collision and lighting fixes across the board
- Fix Episode 2 unlock bug
- Update Episode 3 broadcast

notes.title: Release Date for 1000 Deaths is OUT!
notes.notes:
1000 Deaths will be released on Steam on August 7!


A public demo is available to play on Steam until then, with new 3D platforming levels from the full game in the Arcade. Stay tuned for news about console ports!
